title: Making Pancakes
description: Three short recordings about making pancakes on a Sunday morning.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Getting ready
parts.intro: You will hear Lucy and her dad in the kitchen.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Dad, can we make pancakes for breakfast? It's Sunday.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Good idea, Lucy. First we need flour, eggs and milk. Let's look in the fridge.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: There are only two eggs, but we need three.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Don't worry. Granddad has some eggs. I'll go and ask him.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: I'll wash my hands and get the big bowl. Then I'll put on my apron, because the flour always goes everywhere.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: And please find the frying pan. It's under the sink, I think. No, sorry, it's in the cupboard next to the cooker.

parts.title: Part 2 · The recipe
parts.intro: You will hear Mum explain how to make the pancake mix.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Right, everyone, let's make the pancake mix. First, put two hundred grams of flour in the big bowl.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Then break the eggs and add them. Now pour in the milk slowly, and stir until there are no lumps.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Leave the mix for ten minutes. Meanwhile, I'll heat a little oil in the pan. It must be hot, but not too hot.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Pour a small cup of mix into the pan. After one minute, turn the pancake over. Be careful, it's hot! Then we will put the pancakes on a big plate and keep them warm in the oven.

parts.title: Part 3 · Breakfast time
parts.intro: You will hear Lucy and her dad at the table.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Mmm, these smell lovely! Can I have chocolate sauce on mine?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: I prefer lemon and sugar. My mum always made them that way.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Try one with banana later. They're sweet, and I don't like too much chocolate in the morning.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: OK, but my first one is burnt! Look, it's black on one side.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: That's fine. The first pancake is always bad. Give it to the dog.

script.speaker: Lucy
script.text: Ha ha! I want to make pancakes every Sunday from now on. Maybe next time we can invite Granddad to eat with us.
